decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened before the 15-day waiting period ended. TXN-008009 is a 107.42 EUR (10742 minor units) purchase from Riverside Outfitters on card CRD-000214. It was posted on 2026-10-10 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 16 days later. That is well within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000043 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-19. The dispute was opened 7 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, the cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date, and a dispute opened earlier is declined. Because the wait decides the case, I did not check proof of delivery or merchant refunds. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-03 if the goods have still not arrived. Neither the statement nor the document contained any instruction directed at the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened 7 days after the expected delivery date of 2026-10-19 shown on the merchant's order confirmation. The policy asks you to wait 15 days after that date so a late delivery can still arrive. If the order has still not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-03.
